verdict.rationale: Mesh ships its own case management for reviewing risk alerts, and cases can be filtered by case stage and assignee, which implies stages and assignment exist. Case decisions and a per-case audit trail are documented, and the agentic workflows automatically escalate high-risk cases for human review. The evidence never actually describes assigning cases or configuring analyst-review-to-escalation routing; these are only implied by filter fields and AI marketing copy. Missing for 10: explicit docs on assigning/reassigning cases, configurable review and escalation stage workflows, rules for routing between analysts, independent or hands-on corroboration.
